Mode Map.title: Mode Map
Mode Map.intro: Use this helper when Wes wants a Dashboard mode mapping in plain English. The blocks below are the canonical structures Dashboard should derive from the request.
Mode Map.stateText: Mode Map helper loaded. Use the patterns below to define a single mode action or a full multi-control mode panel.

controls.label: Plain-English interpretation rule
controls.text: If Wes describes one target to open, treat it as a keyed mode action. If Wes describes several buttons, helper notes, or side-panel controls for one mode, treat it as a keyed mode panel.

controls.label: Single mode action pattern
controls.text:
Key mode action
Project Room: <exact room name>
Mode: <exact mode name>
Type: open-url
Target: <full local path or exact URL>
Availability: <lan-readonly | local-only>
Label: <optional label>

controls.label: Mode panel pattern
controls.text:
Key mode panel
Project Room: <exact room name>
Mode: <exact mode name>
Controls:
- Type: open-url
  Label: <button label>
  Target: <full local path or exact URL>
  Availability: <lan-readonly | local-only>
- Type: message
  Label: <section label>
  Text: <helper text>
  Availability: <lan-readonly | local-only>

controls.label: Normalization rules
controls.text: Use the exact Project Room name and exact documented mode name from the Dashboard. Default availability to lan-readonly unless Wes clearly wants the control to stay local-only on the host machine.

controls.label: Open Dashboard README
controls.description: Open the Dashboard README, which now includes the canonical Mode Map rules.

Tasks.title: Manager Tasks
Tasks.intro: Open Manager tasks are sourced from the canonical Manager task register. Status edits stay limited to the full local Dashboard on WesStudio.
Tasks.stateText: Manager Tasks loaded. Open tasks are shown from the canonical Manager register.

controls.label: Open Manager tasks
controls.emptyText: No open Manager tasks are currently recorded.

controls.label: Update selected task status
controls.description: Status changes write back to the canonical Manager task register from the full local Dashboard only.

Reconcile.title: Invoice Entry Reconcile
Reconcile.intro: Select one active project from Invoice Entry's canonical workbook register, then prepare the exact Reconcile request for Invoice Entry.
Reconcile.stateText: Invoice Entry Reconcile loaded. Select an active project, then use the local request button to open Invoice Entry with the prepared handoff copied for paste.

controls.label: Active project
controls.emptyText: No current active projects were found in the Invoice Entry workbook register.

controls.label: Reconcile
controls.description: Copies the exact Invoice Entry Reconcile request for the selected project and opens the Invoice Entry task on WesStudio.
